message.content: {"note_claim": "Society has a term for a man who abandons his child: \"deadbeat dad.\"", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The gender-specific deadbeat father and deadbeat mother are commonly used to refer to people who have parented a child and intentionally fail to pay child support ordered by a family law court or statutory agency.", "reason": "The Wikipedia page explicitly defines \"deadbeat father\" as a gender-specific term for parents who abandon their parental responsibilities, directly supporting the note's claim."}

parsed.note_claim: Society has a term for a man who abandons his child: "deadbeat dad."
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The gender-specific deadbeat father and deadbeat mother are commonly used to refer to people who have parented a child and intentionally fail to pay child support ordered by a family law court or statutory agency.
parsed.reason: The Wikipedia page explicitly defines "deadbeat father" as a gender-specific term for parents who abandon their parental responsibilities, directly supporting the note's claim.
